items.title: Introducing the next generation of serverless time series for Amazon OpenSearch Service
items.summary: The next generation of Amazon OpenSearch Service serverless now supports time series collections. Define the boundaries for cost, performance, security, access, and data retention using simple controls for data tiering, time field selection, and data retention, then turn raw events into insights with the next-generation OpenSearch UI.
items.creator: Kevin Fallis

items.title: From Problem to Fix in Minutes: Automating Search Relevance Tuning with the Amazon OpenSearch Service Relevance Agent
items.summary: The Amazon OpenSearch Service Search Relevance Agent turns a low NDCG score into a better search query in minutes. Describe the problem through the Ask AI chat, and the agent analyzes your User Behavior Insights data, generates an improved query, and validates it with an offline Search Relevance Workbench experiment, all without leaving the UI.
items.creator: Aruna Govindaraju
